account_kind.description: Fee-payer class: none (no account or 0 lamports), system (System wallet), nonce (initialized System nonce account), other (cannot pay fees)

required_fee_sol.description: transactions × signatures × 5,000 lamports, in SOL (priority fees excluded)

description: Can this Solana account pay the fees of N transactions now? When to use: Before sending one or more transactions from a wallet: to learn whether it can pay their base fees without dropping below its rent-exempt minimum. Prefer another tool: To check one SOL or token transfer end to end (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or to read a balance (none is returned). Example: solana_fee_readiness {"address":"83astBRguLMdt2h5U1Tpdq5tjFoJ6noeGwaY3mDLVcri"} Credits only: paid by prepaid credit, 0.0025 EUR or 0.003 USD units per call; buy a bundle first at https://api.criptonlabs.com/v1/pro/credits/{bundle} or with `credits_topup`, then call with the `clc_` token or Sign-In-With-X.

address.description: Fee-payer account: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

signatures.description: Signatures per transaction: integer from 1 to 10; default 1

transactions.description: Number of transactions to pay for: integer from 1 to 1000; default 1
